t: Men's Rebel by Durango X-Pand Western Boots Chocolate (DDB0517) Slip Oil Resistand
d:
Details 
 The upper of this Rebel™ by Durango® Western has been constructed with full-grain leather. The stitching on the tan shaft is handsome and there is a toe bug stitch on the brown-hued foot. A dipped topline and finger holes will allow you to get this 11" squared-toe boot on/off with ease.
 Inside of this western boot, there is a contoured footbed. It provides cushioning that will keep your feet at ease, it's ventilated so your feet will have great aeration and it is removable so you always have the option of adding in another insole once this one starts to wear down.
 The tempered steel shank is another great feature to have, because it gives you steady footing and provides support to your foot's arches.
 The Rebel outsole is made from a blend of rubber and EVA; this combination gives the outsole flexibility, makes it comfortable to stand on and keeps it lightweight. There is also a lower 1 3/8" heel; this allows you to maintain a steady stride.
 These Rebel™ by Durango® Saddle Up Western Boots have a great look, are comfortable to wear and are just a pair of men's boots that you'll want to wear daily.
- Square toe
- EVA midsole
- Tempered steel shank
- Full-grain leather
- Cushion Flex insole
- Rolled shank area
- Soft mesh lining
- Contoured, ventilated and removable cushion footbed
- Double row sole stitch
